id.description: Stable course id. Never rename: it is part of the Moodle idnumber.

source_root.description: Directory holding the kit files, relative to this course.yaml.

due_days.description: INITIAL default: one deadline for the whole course, start + N days, applied to each quiz when it is created. Afterwards administrators edit the dates in Moodle and deploys never overwrite them.

schedule.description: INITIAL default of the per-module deadlines (set as the quiz's "Expect completed on" when created; afterwards administrators own the dates in Moodle). monthly: module N is due at the end of calendar month N (month 1 contains the start date).

require_pdf_view.description: Quiz is locked until the main PDF is viewed.

text.description: Markdown file relative to course.yaml. Variables: {{cycle}} {{due_date}} {{start_date}} {{pass_percent}} {{modules_count}} {{course_title}}.

posters.description: Folder (relative to source_root) with kick-off poster images.

trypticos.description: Folder (relative to source_root) with leaflet PDFs.

trainer_material.description: Publish the PPTX decks in a hidden trainers-only section.

key.description: Stable module key. Never reuse or rename.

folder.description: Module folder relative to source_root. Files inside are discovered by convention.

questions.description: Question bank YAML relative to course.yaml.

due_month.description: INITIAL default: month (1 = month of the start date) whose end is this module's deadline; default is its position in `modules`. Needs completion.schedule. Not applied to activities that already exist.

files.description: Overrides for the convention (paths relative to the module folder; null disables an item).

review.description: INITIAL default (applied when the quiz is created; afterwards administrators edit Review options in Moodle). What a learner sees of an attempt. marks_only: mark. correctness: mark + right/wrong per question, never the correct option. after_close/immediately: also feedback and correct answers (after_close only once the quiz has a close date, which we never set).
